item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.engineering.com/?p=151286","version_id":"a393edb1af792a0f22f58a9c9be7640474dbeb4ed41d7ec336f5428b607cf2bc","decision":"accept","reason":"Fresh, directly relevant commercial coverage: Autodesk executives describe upcoming Fusion task-automation features and an agentic experience layered on Fusion Manage for design-and-manufacturing PLM.
